_provenance._note: Designer-authored TUNE TARGET (not analyzer-extracted snapshot per core/tuner/target_profile.py extract_target). See process_improvements.md #13 for schema split recommendation. Block `_design_targets_v0_M15_only` below is M15-specific Designer-authored design intent — do NOT copy to other machines (contamination per process_improvements.md #2/#3).

bucket_rate._note: v0 Designer does not pin per-bucket rates; tuner cost function uses bucket shape via base CV target + family share floors. Bucket rates derive from family marginals + paytable. Will be populated post-Stage 6 tune by V/A from sim sample, NOT pre-specified.

_design_targets_v0_M15_only._schema_note: Designer-authored bands for tuner cost function bounds. See session_artifacts/M15/design_v0.md §3/§5.1/§6/§7 for derivation. Every number cited.

rtp._source: DESIGN_PHILOSOPHY.md §C mode 1 invariant + user_brief default decision archetype Top Dollar $1 denom ~92% mid + DTD 96.24% online + Boulder Strip $1 94.93%

trigger_rate._source: derivation: feature_rtp_pp 47.5 / feature_ev_x 46 = 1.033% (user_brief #3 + preserve v7 EV per user_brief default)

feature_ev_x._source: user_brief default decision (preserve v7 EV); enables 50:50 with trigger 1.03%

top_jackpot_pay_id_1_cadence_floor._source: DESIGN_PHILOSOPHY.md §7 mode 1 1/50-100k band + user_brief default decision (M15 deviation: dense mid-high, rare top; m1 cadence at ~1/60k = upper band, NOT pushing toward 1/30k or below)

family_share_of_base_floors_pct._note: Per DESIGN_PHILOSOPHY §10 Pareto-trap defense — tune cost function must penalize share drops below floor.

cherry1._source: user_brief default (cherry-anywhere archetype necessity) + DESIGN_PHILOSOPHY §1 cherry-anywhere mechanism

cherry_family_total._source: 01d §3.3 archetype 14-20% of total = 30-42% of base @ 95% RTP

bar_mixed._source: mid-pay broad reach; pareto defense per DESIGN_PHILOSOPHY §10

bar_3_of_kind_total._source: 01d §3.3 + 01b §4 RWB bar 31%; classic 11-31% band; M15 floor 25%

bar1_5x._source: DESIGN_PHILOSOPHY §1 inverse-pyramid: bar1 (5x) most frequent of bar tier

high7_total._source: M15-specific deviation from archetype 30-70% (doublediamond wild absorbs share); floor 2% maintains brand visibility per DESIGN_PHILOSOPHY §2

wild_pure_200x._source: top-jackpot brand pay; DESIGN_PHILOSOPHY §7 cadence dependency

family_hierarchy_invariants._note: Per DESIGN_PHILOSOPHY §1 inverse pyramid — frequency must decrease as payout increases within a family. Verifier red lines.
